name: search
description: Force comprehensive web search using native grounding
instruction: WEB SEARCH MODE: Use YOUR NATIVE WEB SEARCH capability (grounding search) to find comprehensive, real-time information. DO NOT use external tools - your built-in search provides better results with multiple sources synthesized together. Include: current data, news headlines, analysis, and source citations. Format the response with clear sections and bullet points.
examples: /search current bitcoin price and market analysis
/search weather forecast for Portland this week
